locked_design_decisions: Story remains a limited editorial scene and Explorer remains the full aggregate analysis surface
Story and Explorer share release projection domain ViewModels coordinates radius and encoding
canonical SVG viewBox is 720x520 and Story stage is capped at 72rem
light archival Story surface preserves Evidence Line and chapter rhythm
focus halo and selection ring are distinct and simultaneous
mobile node inspector is in flow; mobile Evidence is a Bottom Sheet
filtered nodes do not move and are removed from hit testing and DOM mirror
evidence unavailable does not disable or dim a valid node
signal-red is not used for normal-size text on paper
reduced motion removes scale translate and smooth scroll
optional_refinements: up to three approved persistent Story node annotations
approved topic-bin labels when they do not obscure nodes
visually collapsed DOM navigator with skip-link access

blockers.detail: The observed 16-node list is a candidate simulation and the release-build handoff contains no approved IDs.
Full Explorer has 532 visual and 1133 hit-overlap pairs; the candidate Story subset has 16 visual and 20 hit-overlap pairs. Frontend coordinate mutation is prohibited.
The release build was not rerun after the frontend handoffs appeared; the member-grain SSOT contradiction and remaining data-side inputs still block canonical Story release promotion.
Story has no shared ViewModel renderer and Evidence routes do not consume the Atlas EvidenceRepository.
140 node controls expose only 20 unique accessible names.

decision_requests: Approve and publish the exact 16-node Story contract with selection hash.
Resolve the SSOT member-grain contradiction before release promotion.
Provide upstream bounded display-coordinate acceptance for collision risk without frontend jitter.
Select and publish the canonical runtime release pointer and EvidenceRepository transport.
